answer: Validators ping every agent at random moments, often at dawn when traffic is thin, and record its response jitter. Agents sharing one server show the same ripple of delay, like tracks crossing a single dune, so correlated identities get merged into one payee. To pass, each fake must run on its own host with its own network path, about $5 a month apiece: 100 sybils cost $500 monthly, growing linearly, while honest agents already run alone.
